arjun: Quick follow-up — propose harmonizing token ceilings across accelerators to reduce kernel thrash and KV-frag variance. Sharing profiling + suggested policy.

maya: Need numbers. did you include latency SLO and tail?

arjun: Profile summary (1h sample, p95 < 300ms target):
```
GPU   max_tokens_per_batch  tokens/sec  p95_latency_ms  slo_violations
A10   4096                   68k         270             0.9%
T4    2048                   35k         310             2.7%
L4    3072                   51k         420             6.8%  <-- kernel selector choosing fallback
A100  8192                   120k        190             0.2%
H100  12288                  160k        180             0.1%
```

jess: On L4 we see the kernel selector picking the generic matmul for mixed batchshapes. snippet:
```
[2025-03-14 14:02:11] kernel_select: model=gpt-3k, batch_shapes=[64x512,16x1024] -> chosen=matmul_generic (cost=1.9)
```
We should bias selector toward tiled-kernel for >2k tokens/batch.

sasha: Also observed KV cache fragmentation on long-lived connections. Effective packing drops ~12% and that increases tail. Suggest adding a KV-aware penalty in queue policy so fragmented sessions don't steal large batch slots.

liam: What's the rollout plan? can we A/B and measure unit-cost + p95?

deploy-bot: ci/checks: perf-smoke OK, baseline: a10(68k),l4(51k),t4(35k)

maya: My proposal for 'harmonized ceilings' policy (simplified):
```
base = {A10:4096, T4:2048, L4:3072, A100:8192, H100:12288}
kernel_factor = {fast_tile:1.0, fallback:0.75}
kv_penalty = fragmented ? 0.85 : 1.0
ceiling = floor(base * kernel_factor * kv_penalty)
```
Examples: L4 fallback -> 3072*0.75*1=2304

arjun: Proposed experiment:
- implement ceiling calc in queueer
- run 24h A/B on 10% traffic for each region
- collect p95, unit-cost, kernel choice distribution

jess: I'll add a kernel-tag hint to prefer tiled kernels when batch_tokens > 2000 and re-run selector smoke. Command I'll use:
```
./tools/profile_selector --gpu L4 --warmup 600 --shapes mix --out ./l4_selector_run.json
```

sasha: I'll add KV-frag metric to traces and a boolean flag to queue entry so we can apply kv_penalty.

liam: I'll own the experiment dashboard (per-route: p95, cost/token, kernel-choice). ETA 48h.

arjun: Cool. Action items: jess -> selector hint, sasha -> kv flag + metric, maya -> implement ceiling calc, liam -> dashboard + rollouts. Start tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

maya: noted. will push PR with feature flag.

jess: PR incoming, will include test harness.

deploy-bot: rollout: staged -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (manual holds at each step)

arjun: Thanks team, sync up EOD if anything blocks. :eyes:
